results.title: "I accept it with humility": Pralhad Joshi assumes charge as Union education minister
results.description: Pralhad Joshi has formally assumed charge as the Union Minister for Education. This leadership change follows the resignation of former minister Dharmendra Pradhan. The Cockroach Janta Party withdrew its protest after Pradhan's resignation.
